name: grep-and-glob
description: Exercise grep (basic, case-insensitive, path filter, no match) and glob.

name: grep-options
description: Exercise grep gitignore, negation glob, line-range selector, multiline regex, invalid regex, missing path, and skip pagination.
setup:
mkdir -p src/deep node_modules/x many && printf 'foo one
bar
foo two
' > src/a.txt && printf 'foo deep
' > src/deep/b.txt && printf 'foo ignored
' > node_modules/x/c.txt && printf 'node_modules/
' > .gitignore && printf 'foo hidden
' > .h.txt && for i in $(seq 1 150); do printf 'needle %s
' $i > many/f$i.txt; done && find . -exec touch -t 202001010000 {} + && git init -q .

name: glob-options
description: Exercise glob limit, hidden, gitignore, bare dir, semicolon multi-pattern, no match, empty args, and limit=0.
setup: mkdir -p src/deep node_modules/x many && printf a > src/a.txt && printf b > src/deep/b.txt && printf c > node_modules/x/c.txt && printf 'node_modules/\n' > .gitignore && printf h > .h.txt && for i in $(seq 1 30); do printf n > many/f$i.txt; done && find . -exec touch -t 202001010000 {} + && git init -q .

name: find-semantic
description: Exercise semantic find with find.enabled: on and deterministic loopback chat-judge responses (yes).
